rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

Chunk 2 line 17 'the game has real tests' → 'game' named chunk 1 line 12; chunk 2 line 19 'Before you close the session' → 'session' named chunk 1 line 11. Chunk 3 line 27 'the data feature you seeded at the end of the first session' → resolves to chunk 2 line 19's newly-relocated data-feature bullet (the split moved this bullet from the old combined slide into its own chunk 2, and the forward-pointing reference in chunk 3 still lands cleanly because chunk 2 precedes chunk 3). Chunk 4 line 32 'The running game, the test suite, the commit history, and the one bug' all resolve to chunks 1-2 antecedents ('running' game ch1 l12, 'test suite' ch2 l17, 'real history' ch2 l18, 'the first thing that looks wrong...is your Module 1 bug' ch1 l13).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'the X you did/saw' backward-reference-to-a-beat construction appears anywhere in the body. Chunk 2 line 19's 'Module 3 reads' is a forward reference to a real module, not a backward beat claim.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal or live-demo construction anywhere in the body.

Every chunk carries a self-standing claim: chunk 1 = build steps to a running game, chunk 2 (new split) = add tests, commit discipline, seed a data feature, chunk 3 = the four task sizes, chunk 4 = what to bring. Neither new chunk is a wait-state fragment.

Chunk 2 header 'Leave it with tests and a data surface' truthfully summarizes its 3 bullets (test suite, commit history, data-touching feature) — the two nouns in the header (tests, data surface) both land, and 'commit history' generalizes under the header's implicit 'leave it in good shape' framing without contradicting it. Chunk 1 'Get to a running game' matches its build-to-playable-game bullets. Chunk 3 and chunk 4 headers likewise match their content.

Checked all sub-items per chunk: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triples; no self-grading superlative (grep for 'one of the most', 'best', 'incredibly' → none); no number-with-retraction pattern; no abstraction-noun stacks; no verb triplets with an empty leg. Body is plain instructional prose throughout.

No other dialect terms (beat, mood, compendium, forcing function, firing) appear.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.

This is functionally the check_pedagogy.md §34 task-sizing callout (floor-to-ceiling task-size enumeration) that §9's own exception clause names as outranking the ≤1-bold budget: 'a bolded line that names a task-size floor and ceiling.' rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule text scopes the imperative/claim split to 'Exercise' vs 'Lecture' `##` headings specifically; this file is a supplementary bootstrapping page, neither.
